{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load and clean data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders and refunded orders
completed_only = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != 999999.99)]

# Verify the cleanup
print('Final dataset shape:', completed_only.shape)
print('Remaining channels:', completed_only['channel'].unique())
print('Remaining segments:', completed_only['customer_segment'].unique())

# Check for any remaining QA orders
print('QA orders remaining? (revenue == 999999.99):', (completed_only['revenue'] == 999999.99).sum())

# Check for refunded orders
print('Refunded orders remaining? (status == refunded):', (completed_only['status'] == 'refunded').sum())"}
